Senses.Explanation: Somewhat closer or a little better by comparison. The phrase occurs 854 times in 224 allowlisted texts and repeatedly serves as a qualified public appraisal. Huangbo Xiyun says that among Mazu Daoyi’s eighty-four teachers only Guizong Zhichang is somewhat closer. Xitang Zhizang summons the assembly and says that the record's unnamed participant who tries to help is somewhat closer. After an interlocutor whom the record does not name says he does not understand, Guanghui Qingshun replies that this is a little closer. Baiyan Fu says that Fu Dashi, Baozhi, and Emperor Wu still do not compare quite as well with Yan's action. Yuanwu Keqin says that being entirely unlike a list of proposed identifications is only then somewhat closer, and immediately asks why. Changqing Huileng applies the phrase after a long silence. The comparison can therefore qualify speech, silence, action, withdrawal, or the condition before a question while still withholding full approval.
Senses.Note: The Chan deployment turns an ordinary small comparison into a clipped public verdict: 'closer' regularly does not mean accepted or complete. The texts supply the compared speech or action and retain the phrase as a comparative appraisal. All occurrences are comparative appraisals of the same kind, so no sense split is warranted.
